# Andy Howell

Andy Howell is the current Deputy of [District 3](https://flow.je/elections/district-3) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2022.

Andy Howell has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/andy-howell#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 3 with 45.4% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/andy-howell/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ysk_Rs6VSb0)

Andy Howell has declared her intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Connétables Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [Trinity](https://flow.je/elections/trinity). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/02/24/trinity-to-have-contested-constables-election-for-first-time-in-30-years/)\]
